# SurfaceOne for React Native — component catalogue

Install: `npm install @surface-one/react-native react-native-svg`. Every component is exported from `@surface-one/react-native`; its props follow the React twin (see the docs page), with `onPress` for `onClick` and `style` for `className`.

## Layout

Structure a screen: sidebars, cards and dividers.

### Card

A surface that groups related content, with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

- Import: `import { SoneCard, SoneCardAction, SoneCardContent, SoneCardDescription, SoneCardFooter, SoneCardHeader, SoneCardTitle } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/card/

### Separator

A one-pixel hairline between content, horizontal or vertical, decorative or semantic.

- Import: `import { SoneSeparator } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/separator/

### Collapsible

Show and hide a region with a trigger that keeps aria-expanded and aria-controls in sync.

- Import: `import { SoneCollapsible, SoneCollapsibleContent, SoneCollapsibleIcon, SoneCollapsibleTrigger } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/collapsible/

### Section Heading

The heading row of a section: a real h2 to h4 named by its title alone (an optional count is read after it), with actions at the end.

- Import: `import { SoneSectionHeading } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/section-heading/

### Disclosure

A progressive-disclosure section following the WAI-ARIA Disclosure pattern.

- Import: `import { SoneDisclosure } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/disclosure/

## Element

The small building blocks: buttons, badges, alerts and indicators.

### Alert

A callout for important information, with title, description, action and five tones.

- Import: `import { SoneAlert, SoneAlertAction, SoneAlertDescription, SoneAlertDialog, SoneAlertTitle } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/alert/

### Avatar

A user image with initials fallback and a generic glyph when signed out.

- Import: `import { SoneAvatar, SoneAvatarFallback, SoneAvatarGroup, SoneAvatarImage } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/avatar/

### Badge

A compact label for status, counts or tags, with six variants and four status tints.

- Import: `import { SoneBadge, SoneBadgeRemove } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/badge/

### Banner

A one-line status callout with a leading glyph; errors and warnings are announced to screen readers.

- Import: `import { SoneBanner, SoneBannerGlyph } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/banner/

### Confirm

An inline confirmation in place of a modal: title, description and error, Cancel then Confirm, focus on the action, Escape to cancel and a busy state.

- Import: `import { SoneConfirm, SoneConfirmActions, SoneConfirmDescription, SoneConfirmError, SoneConfirmTitle } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/confirm/

### Button

The one button: six variants, four text sizes and four square icon sizes, plus button groups.

- Import: `import { SoneButton, SoneButtonGroup } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/button/

### Icon

Inline SVG glyphs drawn in currentColor — no icon font, no extra request.

- Import: `import { SoneIcon } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/icon/

### Progress

A linear progress bar, determinate or indeterminate, with an accessible progressbar role.

- Import: `import { SoneProgress } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/progress/

### Meter

A segmented indicator for coarse, ordinal quantities like accuracy or speed.

- Import: `import { SoneMeter } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/meter/

### Skeleton

A pulsing placeholder sized by its host while content loads.

- Import: `import { SoneSkeleton } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/skeleton/

### Spinner

A spinning loader drawn in currentColor at any size.

- Import: `import { SoneSpinner } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/spinner/

### Status Dot

A small round status mark in a semantic tone, with an optional pulse and accessible name.

- Import: `import { SoneStatusDot } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/status-dot/

## Form

Inputs, selects, switches, sliders and choice controls.

### Field & Input Group

Fields, labels, descriptions, errors and input groups with addons — native inputs styled by the system.

- Import: `import { SoneField, SoneFieldContent, SoneFieldDescription, SoneFieldError, SoneFieldGroup, SoneFieldLabel, SoneFieldLabelOptional, SoneFieldLegend, SoneFieldSeparator, SoneFieldSet, SoneFieldTitle, SoneInput, SoneInputGroup, SoneInputGroupAddon, SoneInputGroupInput, SoneInputGroupText, SoneInputGroupTextarea } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/input/

### Select

A native select as a form control with projected options.

- Import: `import { SoneSelect } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/select/

### Switch

An on/off switch that works as a form control, in two sizes.

- Import: `import { SoneSwitch } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/switch/

### Slider

A range slider with an accent fill and a round thumb, usable as a form control.

- Import: `import { SoneSlider } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/slider/

### Segmented

A single-choice segmented control rendered from data — the Light / Dark / System pattern.

- Import: `import { SoneSegmented } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/segmented/

### Toggle Group & Tabs

Toggles, toggle groups and tabs with roving focus and every orientation.

- Import: `import { SoneToggleGroup, SoneToggleGroupItem } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/toggle-group/

### Search Field

A search box with a search glyph, a clear button, Enter to submit and Escape to clear, as a form control.

- Import: `import { SoneSearchField } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/search-field/

### Filter Chips

One-of-many filter buttons from data, as chips or tabs, with a count badge per option and arrow-key navigation.

- Import: `import { SoneFilterChips } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/filter-chips/

### Choice Card

Rich radio cards where the whole card is the option, with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

- Import: `import { SoneChoiceCard, SoneChoiceCardDescription, SoneChoiceCardIndicator, SoneChoiceCardTitle } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/choice-card/

### Copy Button

Copy a value to the clipboard with a brief “Copied” confirmation that screen readers hear too.

- Import: `import { SoneCopyButton } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/copy-button/

### Input OTP

A one-time code input: one real field drawn as separate slots, so paste, autofill and screen readers just work.

- Import: `import { SoneInputOtp } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/input-otp/

### Password Input

A password field with a show / hide toggle, as a form control.

- Import: `import { SonePasswordInput } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/password-input/

### Stepper

Progress through a multi-step flow as dots or numbered steps, with a “Step x of y” count.

- Import: `import { SoneStepper } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/stepper/

### Input Number

A number field with minus and plus buttons — a spinbutton with arrow, Page Up / Down and Home / End keys, clamped to min and max, as a form control.

- Import: `import { SoneInputNumber } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/input-number/

### Rating

Stars for a score — a read-only image that fills fractions, or a radio group to rate with the keyboard, as a form control.

- Import: `import { SoneRating } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/rating/

## Data

Show records: tables, items, lists and empty states.

### Item

A row of media, title, description and actions — for lists and settings.

- Import: `import { SoneItem, SoneItemActions, SoneItemContent, SoneItemDescription, SoneItemFooter, SoneItemGroup, SoneItemHeader, SoneItemMedia, SoneItemSeparator, SoneItemTitle } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/item/

### Load More

The “Show more” button at the end of a paged list, with the remaining count, a loading state and a retry on error.

- Import: `import { SoneLoadMore } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/load-more/

### Chart Legend

Colour swatches and a chart legend whose items can toggle series on and off.

- Import: `import { SoneChartLegend } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/chart-legend/

### Stacked Bar

One bar split into the parts of a whole, with an optional remainder track, a legend and a spoken summary.

- Import: `import { SoneStackedBar } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/stacked-bar/

### Stat

Key figures in a description list — label, value, hint and trend, as cards, inset tiles or a plain inline row.

- Import: `import { SoneStat, SoneStatGroup, SoneStatHint, SoneStatLabel, SoneStatTrend, SoneStatValue } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/stat/

### Bar List

A ranked list of labelled horizontal bars with the value beside each, scaled to the largest value or the total; labels can be any template.

- Import: `import { SoneBarList } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/bar-list/

### Sparkline

A word-sized line, area, bar or heat chart without axes in one stretched SVG, decorative by default or an image with a spoken summary.

- Import: `import { SoneSparkline } from "@surface-one/react-native";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/sparkline/

## Not in @surface-one/react-native yet

Sidebar, Collapsible Section, Side Panel, Kbd, Logo, Download Progress, Power Slider, Secret Field, Tag Input, Table, Empty, Source List, Bar Chart, Graph, Tree Row, Command, Tree, Menu & Popover, Row Menu, Tooltip, Page Actions, Chat, Terminal, Agent Chat, Chat History, Message, Bubble, Marker, Markdown & Editor, Audio Player, Recording, Floating Bar, Transcript, Live Transcript, Timeline, Speaker Chip, Flow, Dock — web only for now.
